title: 2026 UK GHG biogas/natural-gas separation methodology QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology note documents a change to distinguish biogas from natural gas in the distribution network.
Biogas and natural-gas use from the gas distribution network are separated in inventory estimates for the first time under the described change.
facts.expected_handling: Keep fossil and biofuel categories separate.

facts.source_fact: Previously biogas in the distribution network was treated as a component of natural gas and was not separately distinguishable.
facts.expected_handling: Mark legacy blended values as superseded classification.

facts.source_fact: An external review identified transparency concerns with the previous blended approach.
DUKES data on biogas injection into the gas distribution network are used to produce separate fossil-fuel and biofuel-use emissions estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Carry DUKES source and injection-data provenance.

facts.source_fact: The overall impact of the biogas separation on UK emissions totals is minimal.
facts.expected_handling: Do not interpret reclassification as a large change in total emissions.

facts.source_fact: Most biogas and natural-gas blending occurs in the gas distribution network.
facts.expected_handling: Apply blend logic only where network context supports it.

facts.source_fact: Large-scale consumers or upstream oil-and-gas sites with more direct gas supply are treated as natural-gas users rather than assuming network biogas blending.
facts.expected_handling: Use supply-route evidence before assigning a biogas fraction.

facts.source_fact: Gas-use apportionment is revised across industry, fuel supply, electricity supply, domestic transport, buildings and product uses, and agriculture sectors.
facts.expected_handling: Keep sector allocation and fuel classification linked.

facts.source_fact: The final 1990-2024 UK GHG statistics were published and updated after the planning note in 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Cross-check final production values against the final release.

guard_patterns.handling: Keep biogas and fossil natural gas separate.
Bind fuel split to the correct TES sector.
Distinguish total-emission effect from reallocation effect.
Use final release for final values.
Do not infer parcel fuel mix or emissions.
Flag missing supply-route or fuel-class evidence.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
